description: Open a human-reviewed feedback form and submit it to the Bucky product team. Call only when the user explicitly asks to send feedback, report a problem, suggest an improvement, or praise something. The server asks the MCP client to show the form; nothing is saved unless the human accepts it. Do not use for silent agent self-reporting.

affectedToolName.description: Tool the user is commenting on, when already known

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

submissionId.description: Optional. A UUID for this submission; generated server-side when omitted. Pass the same UUID when retrying this exact feedback so it is not recorded twice.

name: submitBuckyFeedback
title: Submit feedback to Bucky
